summary: Complete redesign of homepage styling. Light theme: white background, professional blue accent (#2563eb), system font stack (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, etc.) replacing Space Grotesk. summary: Homepage + demo/live/notebook-wrapper stylesheet and token source of truth (--display Newsreader, --sans IBM Plex Sans, --mono JetBrains Mono; --frost/--ember palette). Styles hero, nav (including the `.nav-drop` dropdown), footer, the `.faq` block, and the shared `.card`/`.card-top`/`.pill` note-card component — rewritten this session from a warm 'paper' theme to one dark treatment (`--ink-2` background, no rotation) used identically on the homepage exhibit and the /demo/ recall timeline (`.recall{gap:18px}`, `.recall .card{margin:8px 0}`). summary: Homepage stylesheet and token source of truth (--display Newsreader, --sans IBM Plex Sans, --mono JetBrains Mono; --frost/--ember palette); also styles nav, footer, the .faq block and the shared .card note-card. Now built on a TWO-COLUMN SPINE: .two is a 5fr/7fr grid with .col-a (the argument, sticky at top:88px above 1024px) and .col-b (the artifact), collapsing to one column below 900px; its ::before draws the column hairline at left:calc((100% - 48px) * 5 / 12 + 24px). Every section uses that one shape and nothing is centred. Section backgrounds were removed on purpose — .navsec/.phil/.faq no longer sit on --ink-1, .nb no longer has its warm ground plus two radial blobs, and .hero::before's glow is gone — because backdrop.css now paints one continuous field under the whole page and sections are divided by a hairline instead of a band of colour.

summary: Homepage stylesheet and token source of truth (--display Newsreader, --sans IBM Plex Sans, --mono JetBrains Mono; --frost/--ember palette); also styles nav, footer, the .faq block and the shared .card note-card. Layout is STACKED, FULL-WIDTH, CENTRED sections - the .two/.col-a/.col-b two-column spine described by an earlier version of this note was reverted in 0867280 and no longer exists. It was reverted because a DOM probe across six dev-tool landing pages found that nextjs.org, vercel.com and railway.com use ZERO two-column grids, nobody repeats an asymmetric split as a page spine, and 5 of 6 centre some text; the spine also ran ~375px / ~44 chars per line, below the measured 429-550px band. What DID survive the revert is the removal of every per-section background: .navsec/.phil/.faq no longer sit on --ink-1, .nb no longer has its warm ground plus two radial blobs, and .hero::before's glow is gone, because backdrop.css now paints one continuous field under the whole page and sections are divided by a hairline instead of a band of colour. The .tl traffic-light rules were also deleted here (and in docs.css) when the dots were removed sitewide.
